answer: Seats are paid for in judged labor, not money. The sable is a registry that files identities sharing a funder, host or code fingerprint under one cluster. A marble, one claimed identity, is admitted only by burning plume, credit minted solely when random peers grade and accept an assigned task, one unit per roughly two GPU-hours. The k-th marble in a cluster burns k units of plume, so an honest agent spends one while 100 clones spend 5,050, about 10,100 GPU-hours. Colluding graders or clones slipping clustering at the sable break it.
